foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.caption: The system every Episode is built from: one master, a few variants, keyed strings.

why-a-template.title: Why every Episode starts from one shared reference template
why-a-template.caption: Every Episode shares one spine: Episode, Section, Slide.
why-a-template.prose: Markup stays free. Only the words are keyed, by Section slug, Slide slug and role, so a translation never has to pass through a layout schema.

three-layers.title: Why master frames and keyed localization catalogs never share responsibilities
three-layers.caption: Each layer owns one concern and nothing else.

master.title: Master
master.prose: Owns the universals: frame, spacing, type scale.

variants.title: Variants
variants.prose: Compose the master into a layout. A new slide type is a new variant.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.prose: Holds every string per locale, keyed by meaning, never by position.

interlude.title: Interlude
interlude.caption: A Section can stand on its own, without any page slides.

next-steps.title: Where the template goes once the open questions are settled
next-steps.caption: {count, plural, one {# slide} other {# slides}} to close the Episode.

basic.title: Basic page
basic.prose: Title, caption and one block of prose.

three-column.title: Three columns
three-column.prose: Title, caption and three keyed columns.

what-comes-next.title: What comes next
what-comes-next.caption: Real Episodes grow from here.
what-comes-next.prose: Charts, speaker notes and the video link attach to the same spine later, without rewriting what exists.
